transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’ve been having trouble keeping my mind on one thing. At the warehouse, a beeper or forklift alarm, or somebody moving a pallet, pulls me off what I’m doing. Then I look back and realize I’ve entered the wrong inventory numbers.
How long have you been dealing with these difficulties with your attention?
About a month now. It started around when my husband stopped working outside the home and our usual routine changed.
Over the past month, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling down all the time.
Over the past month, have you been feeling frequently nervous, anxious, or on edge?
I’m not sure I’d say I’ve been feeling anxious a lot. I haven’t really noticed being on edge.
Did you experience similar problems with attention or staying focused when you were a child in school?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having problems focusing in school as a child.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed losing interest in the things I usually do.
Have you been having trouble falling or staying asleep over the past month?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any particular trouble falling asleep or staying asleep.
Have you noticed feeling unusually irritable or short-tempered recently?

Yeah, some days I feel almost too upbeat, like I can get everything fixed at home and at work before dinner. But if my husband questions one of my plans, I can snap at him over something pretty small.
Is this the first time in your life you have experienced a period of feeling this unusually upbeat or energized?
I’m not sure. I can’t really say whether this is the first time or not.
Have you ever had a period in your life lasting two weeks or more where you felt persistently depressed, down, or hopeless?
I’m not sure, honestly. I can’t think of a time like that off the top of my head.
Have you felt that you needed much less sleep than usual while still feeling fully energized?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to how much sleep I’ve been getting.
Have you noticed your thoughts racing or jumping rapidly from one idea to another?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really noticed my thoughts jumping around, but I haven’t been paying close attention to that.
Have you or others noticed that you have been talking much more or faster than usual?

My husband and coworkers have said I talk really fast sometimes—about recipes, safety ideas, art classes—and they can’t get a word in. I feel like I have to get every thought out before it disappears.
Have these changes in your mood and energy caused major problems with your ability to do your job or manage your daily responsibilities?

A little, yes. I’ve made some inventory errors at work and had to go back and double-check things with my supervisor. And at home, my husband and I have been arguing enough that it feels like we’re just walking around each other instead of settling into his retirement.
